subject.title: fix(update): repair plugin config during upgrade finalization

question: Is this PR intentionally the full 2026.7.2-beta.5 release-preparation bundle, or should it be reduced to the merged updater/Doctor backport?
rationale: The central repair is already merged on main, but the proposed release-branch merge includes many additional publication, package, documentation, generated-artifact, and UI changes whose inclusion cannot be inferred from the backport title.

options.title: Split to the updater backport
options.body: Create or refresh a release-branch PR containing only the required updater/Doctor commits and their necessary tests.

options.title: Approve the release bundle explicitly
options.body: Keep the broader branch only if the release owner confirms each release, workflow, dependency, and generated-artifact change belongs in this beta cut.

recommendation.title: Split to the updater backport
recommendation.body: Create or refresh a release-branch PR containing only the required updater/Doctor commits and their necessary tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows recent ownership of the release-pipeline and upstream updater changes that determine whether the broad beta bundle is intentional.
